definitions.explanation: A photograph one takes of oneself, typically with a smartphone held at arm's length or using a selfie stick.

examples.japanese: {観光地|かんこうち}で{自撮|じど}りした。
examples.english: I took a selfie at the tourist spot.

examples.japanese: {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}を{使|つか}って{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I took a photo using a selfie stick.

examples.japanese: SNSに{載|の}せるために、{何枚|なんまい}も{自撮|じど}りして{一番|いちばん}いいのを{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I took many selfies to post on social media and picked the best one.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb: {自撮|じど}りする. A modern word that emerged with the spread of smartphones. The English loanword セルフィー is also used but less common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自撮|じど}りする (to take a selfie)
- {自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう} (selfie stick)
- {自撮|じど}り{写真|しゃしん} (selfie photo)
